desc: We’ve sold a high number of 6P, G2, G2Z, Z2 and M95x tactical illumination tools over the years, and many of our customers still rely on them because they’ve never let down their owners. The SureFire P60 fits 6-volt SureFire incandescent flashlights and WeaponLights with a 1.25-inch bezel. It produces 65 lumens of white light with approximately 1 hour of runtime, and it is specified by the same engineers who designed your Surefire handheld light. Accept nothing less than genuine SureFire replacement parts.
